questions.prompt: `gen2-fetch-deploy.sh` emits zero ShellCheck findings. What does this prove?

options.a: It is completely safe to deploy in production
options.b: It only proves there are no syntax errors ShellCheck detects; trust boundaries, checksum validation, and fail-loud error handling are absent

questions.prompt: Why is running `curl -s` without `--fail` dangerous in an automated deployment script?

options.a: An HTTP 404 or 500 error page is written to the output file while `curl` still exits 0

questions.prompt: Why is `for f in $(ls $DIR)` flagged as an ERROR severity finding (SC2045) by ShellCheck?

options.a: The subshell loop splits filenames on whitespace, breaking on any filename containing a space
